🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Fellowship Evening – Strengthening Rotary Bonds

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange with Argentina, Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown enjoyed a memorable fellowship evening at the residence of Rtn. Virginia.

The gathering brought together 36 Rotarians and Anns, creating a wonderful platform for fellowship and international friendship. We were honoured by the presence of **District Governor Gustavo J. Tondi**, **Indian Ambassador to Argentina Shri Ajaneesh Kumar**, and **DGE Monica**, making the evening even more special.

The atmosphere was filled with warmth, laughter, camaraderie and meaningful interactions. Rotarians from District 3141 and District 4895 came together not merely as members of different Rotary districts, but as one global Rotary family.

The evening beautifully reflected the true essence of the Rotary Friendship Exchange—building relationships, experiencing cultures and creating friendships that transcend borders.

36 Rotarians & Anns • 2 Districts • 2 Countries • One Rotary Family ❤️

A truly wonderful evening of Fellowship • Friendship • International Understanding.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
